create_gym_env: create a Gym environment with action rescaling and episode monitoring for reinforcement learning
create_dm_control_env: create a DMC environment from domain and task name with configurable random seed
create_pixel_observation_env: create an environment with pixel observations using PixelObservationWrapper and configurable image size
create_frame_stacked_env: create an environment with frame stacking for temporal observation history in RL training
create_video_recorded_env: create an environment that records video episodes to a specified save folder for visualization
